italy.deck: The CGIL union's 24-hour general strike brings some 100 marches across Italy, schools and buses halted, as workers protest the 2027 budget and the cost of living. The Rome march sets off at 9:30 from Piazza Vittorio.
italy.headline: Italy stops work for a day
italy.photo_caption: A CROWDED STREET IN ROME — FILE PHOTO

kyiv.deck: Debris from a Russian missile strike set a three-storey building ablaze in the Obolonskyi district in the early hours of Friday; residents across the capital heard explosions. Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported the fire on Telegram.
kyiv.headline: Missiles strike Kyiv at dawn
kyiv.photo_caption: KYIV AND THE DNIPRO AT FIRST LIGHT — FILE PHOTO

lead.deck: Severe Cyclone Akvan crosses the coast near Gopalpur around noon, with winds of 90–100 km/h gusting to 110. Over 300,000 people evacuated; 423 rescue teams deployed, 69 trains cancelled.
lead.headline: Akvan slams into India's east coast
lead.photo_caption: PALM TREES BEND IN THE WIND ON A STORM-LASHED COAST — FILE PHOTO

markets.deck: A day after the Taiex fell 4.4% — its worst month since 2008 — Taiwan caps intraday borrowed shares at 1% and bars shorting below the close after a 3.5% drop.
markets.headline: Taipei's short-selling curbs take effect today
